items.html: Know that these seven kings are ten, but they are like the seven halls, which are ten but they are called seven because the top hall contains the first three halls, and the bottom hall contains the last two halls. It is exactly the same with these seven kings, for they are ten, but they are called only seven. Since these kings are the phases of judgements and Gevurot, it follows that they are all female, as the female is all judgement.
